question: Should ClickClack expose a second persistent message-alignment preference for all non-self participants?
rationale: The implementation is narrow and compatibility-preserving, but code review cannot determine whether the additional durable appearance surface and self-versus-others model match the intended product.

options.title: Sponsor independent alignment
options.body: Accept the additive preference because it enables every self/other layout combination without changing existing defaults or stored self-alignment values.

options.title: Keep one preference
options.body: Decline the extra durable setting and retain the simpler existing alignment model until stronger product demand establishes the need.

recommendation.title: Sponsor independent alignment
recommendation.body: Accept the additive preference because it enables every self/other layout combination without changing existing defaults or stored self-alignment values.
